note: Adds appliedCreditBalance and amountDueToday selectors to billingProductLogic; purchase/upgrade modals and addon card labels now read them, making card labels credit-aware.
Renames workflow/env knobs from events to data, moves filter extraction to filter_storage, adds query SETTINGS; the nested closure logic is not extracted into a pure function.
Contract test now asserts the field list equals the keys actually emitted by _serialize_team_to_llm_gateway_policy, alongside reducing the policy fields.
Moves recording-api and recording-rasterizer out of the ingestion sessionreplay tree to top-level nodejs/src directories and updates imports.
Renames the assistant tool from create_parser_recipe to create_ai_trace_parser across schema, constants, backend tools and tests.
Replaces cursor-based initial-load inference with an is_initial_sync parameter passed from the source based on the schema's initial sync state.
Drops Chart.js mentions from the hog-charts dates test name and a comment in dates.ts.
Merge-conflict fix moves early_exit from per-group to flag-level FlagFilters; the field keeps the early_exit name rather than being renamed.
Renames the skill to generic diagnosing-stacktrace-symbolication, moves JS guidance to references/javascript.md, and marks the script as JavaScript-only.
Moves used/sorted properties and condition enrichment into kea selectors; the raw show-all-properties button remains unchanged.
Adds a determinator package-rule marking personhog-test-harness affected and gates the CI job on the affected crates output.
Drops bespoke scim_* backend log_activity calls in favor of model-signal logs plus a frontend describer and an OrganizationDomain ActivityScope enum entry.
Renames the task origin product choice from experiment to experiments across model, migration, service and generated clients.
Renames the LogsSamplingRule model and migration to LogsExclusionRule and updates the semgrep rule reference.
Removes per-platform account endpoints from integrations, adds an OAuthMixin account-listing method implemented by sources and a generic external data source endpoint.
Removes the opensearch profile entries from docker-compose.profiles.yml and adds the profiles directly in docker-compose.dev.yml.
Replaces lazy inline-SVG hoggies with PNG-rendered hoggies and bans inline-SVG imports; simplifies loading differently rather than lazy-loading the nav ad component.
Switches generation lookups to ai_events via trace-id resolution and a new formatter; service and data logic remain mixed in the tools module.
Adds an origin-marker dedup in the apply handler and a new merge_protocol test; no shared tests/common fixtures module is introduced.
Moves destination archiving from a pre_delete signal to the facade delete and edits a comment; the team FK keeps its named related_name.
